experiences.title: AI Software Engineer
experiences.description: Built an internal RAG-based Q&A system using LangChain and OpenAI API that reduced policy document lookup time by 60% across three underwriting teams. Designed an agentic AI workflow to automate multi-step data extraction from unstructured financial reports, cutting per-analyst manual processing from 4 hours to under 30 minutes. Integrated LLM-based summarization into an existing document review pipeline, reducing review time by 40% while maintaining 95%+ accuracy on flagged compliance items. Deployed the AI service on AWS Lambda with auto-scaling configured to handle 200+ concurrent requests while keeping average response latency under 1.2 seconds.

experiences.title: Software Development Engineer
experiences.description: Developed a microservices-based claims processing API in Node.js and Express, bringing average endpoint response time down from 900ms to 220ms through query restructuring and Redis caching. Migrated a legacy monolithic billing module to containerized services on Kubernetes, reducing deployment time from 3 hours to under 20 minutes per release. Automated CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions across six backend services, cutting manual release steps by 80% and reducing postdeployment incidents. Optimized PostgreSQL queries against a 5M+ record claims database, reducing scheduled report generation time by 55%. Implemented JWT authentication and role-based access control across four internal APIs, resulting in zero unauthorized access incidents in production following rollout.

experiences.title: Associate Software Engineer
experiences.description: Built RESTful APIs for the home warranty claims module in Python, handling 10,000+ daily requests with 99.5% uptime over the first six months post-launch. Streamlined MongoDB data models for service request tracking, cutting average query execution time by 45% and supporting a 3x increase in concurrent users without infrastructure changes. Configured Docker-based development environments for a five-member team, shortening new engineer onboarding from two weeks to three days. Refactored a Python batch processing script handling vendor invoice ingestion, reducing runtime from 12 minutes to under 2 minutes for batches of 50,000+ records. Wrote unit and integration tests in PyTest achieving 80%+ code coverage, which reduced production bug reports by 30% across two consecutive release cycles.
